mapper.select: SELECT RECOMMEND.RECM_NUMB, BOOK.BOOK_NUMB, BOOK.BOOK_TITL, BOOK.BOOK_ATHR, BOOK.BOOK_PUBL , BOOK.BOOK_ISBN, BOOK.BOOK_CVIM, BOOK.BOOK_DESC, DATE_FORMAT(BOOK.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE , USERX.USER_NICK , CASE WHEN RECOMMEND.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS MINE_YSNO , CASE WHEN VOTE.USER_NUMB IS NULL THEN #{commNo} ELSE #{commYes} END AS VOTE_YSNO FROM TB_CLBREC RECOMMEND JOIN TM_BKINFO BOOK ON BOOK.BOOK_NUMB = RECOMMEND.BOOK_NUMB JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = RECOMMEND.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} LEFT JOIN TB_CLBVOT VOTE ON VOTE.CLUB_NUMB = RECOMMEND.CLUB_NUMB AND VOTE.RECM_NUMB = RECOMMEND.RECM_NUMB AND VOTE.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} WHERE RECOMMEND.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} ORDER BY RECOMMEND.REGI_DATE, RECOMMEND.RECM_NUMB
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CLBREC (CLUB_NUMB, BOOK_NUMB, USER_NUMB, REGI_DATE) VALUES (#{clubNumb}, #{request.bookNumb}, #{userNumb}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_CLBREC WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND RECM_NUMB = #{recmNumb} AND USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CLBVOT (CLUB_NUMB, USER_NUMB, RECM_NUMB, REGI_DATE, UPDT_DATE) SELECT #{clubNumb}, #{userNumb}, RECM_NUMB, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM TB_CLBREC WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND RECM_NUMB = #{recmNumb} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE RECM_NUMB = VALUES(RECM_NUMB), UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT /* getActiveMemberUserNumbList */ MEMBER.USER_NUMB FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} ORDER BY CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_ROLE = #{ownerRole} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , MEMBER.JOIN_DATE , MEMBER.USER_NUMB
SELECT /* getNextReadingRoundNumb */ COALESCE(MAX(ROND_NUMB), 0) + 1 FROM TM_CLRNDX WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb}

SELECT /* getReadingForUpdate */ ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB , ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB , ROUNDX.ROND_STAT , ROUNDX.GOAL_STDT , ROUNDX.GOAL_ENDT , BOOK.BOOK_NUMB , BOOK.BOOK_TITL , BOOK.BOOK_ATHR , BOOK.BOOK_PUBL , BOOK.BOOK_ISBN , BOOK.BOOK_CVIM , BOOK.BOOK_DESC , DATE_FORMAT(BOOK.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE FROM TM_CLRNDX ROUNDX JOIN TM_BKINFO BOOK ON BOOK.BOOK_NUMB = ROUNDX.BOOK_NUMB WHERE ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB = #{rondNumb} AND ROUNDX.ROND_STAT IN (#{roundScheduled}, #{roundReading}) FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getReadingReportNumbListForUpdate */ REPORT.REPT_NUMB FROM TB_CLPART PART JOIN TM_REPORT REPORT ON REPORT.REPT_NUMB = PART.REPT_NUMB WHERE PART.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND PART.ROND_NUMB = #{rondNumb} ORDER BY REPORT.REPT_NUMB FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptExpiredReadingParticipantGoal */ TB_CLPART PART JOIN TM_CLRNDX ROUNDX ON ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB = PART.ROND_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_REPORT REPORT ON REPORT.REPT_NUMB = PART.REPT_NUMB AND REPORT.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB SET PART.GOAL_YSNO = CASE WHEN REPORT.REPT_STAT = #{reportDone} THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END , PART.ACHV_DATE = CASE WHEN REPORT.REPT_STAT = #{reportDone} THEN COALESCE(PART.ACHV_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ELSE NULL END , PART.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE ROUNDX.ROND_STAT IN (#{roundScheduled}, #{roundReading}) AND DATE(ROUNDX.GOAL_ENDT) < CURRENT_DATE AND PART.GOAL_YSNO IS NULL

UPDATE /* uptExpiredReadingRound */ TM_CLRNDX ROUNDX SET ROUNDX.ROND_STAT = #{roundCompleted} , ROUNDX.OPEN_DATE = COALESCE(ROUNDX.OPEN_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) , ROUNDX.COMP_DATE = COALESCE(ROUNDX.COMP_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) , ROUNDX.UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE ROUNDX.ROND_STAT IN (#{roundScheduled}, #{roundReading}) AND DATE(ROUNDX.GOAL_ENDT) < CURRENT_DATE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLPART PART WHERE PART.CLUB_NUMB = ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB AND PART.ROND_NUMB = ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB AND PART.GOAL_YSNO IS NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserInterestCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TB_USINTR WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
mapper.sql: CLUB.CLUB_NUMB , CLUB.OWNR_NUMB , OWNER.USER_NICK AS OWNR_NICK , CLUB.CLUB_NAME , CLUB.CLUB_CNTN , CLUB.CLUB_VISB , CLUB.JOIN_TYPE , CLUB.CLUB_STAT , CLUB.MAXX_MEMB , CLUB.REGI_DATE , COALESCE(SEAT.MEMBER_CNT, 0) AS MEMBER_CNT , COALESCE(SEAT.INVITED_CNT, 0) AS INVITED_CNT

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB , SUM(CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MEMBER_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberInvited} AND MEMBER.EXPR_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INVITED_CNT FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER GROUP BY MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB ) SEAT ON SEAT.CLUB_NUMB = CLUB.CLUB_NUMB

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB , ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB , ROUNDX.BOOK_NUMB , ROUNDX.GOAL_STDT , ROUNDX.GOAL_ENDT FROM TM_CLRNDX ROUNDX JOIN ( SELECT LATEST.CLUB_NUMB , MAX(LATEST.ROND_NUMB) AS ROND_NUMB FROM TM_CLRNDX LATEST WHERE LATEST.ROND_STAT IN (#{roundScheduled}, #{roundReading}) GROUP BY LATEST.CLUB_NUMB ) CURRENTX ON CURRENTX.CLUB_NUMB = ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB AND CURRENTX.ROND_NUMB = ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB ) CURRENT_ROUND ON CURRENT_ROUND.CLUB_NUMB = CLUB.CLUB_NUMB

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PART.CLUB_NUMB , PART.ROND_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS GOAL_MEMB_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN REPT.REPT_STAT = #{reportDone} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS GOAL_ACHV_CNT FROM TB_CLPART PART LEFT JOIN TM_REPORT REPT ON REPT.REPT_NUMB = PART.REPT_NUMB AND REPT.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} WHERE PART.ANON_YSNO = #{commNo} GROUP BY PART.CLUB_NUMB , PART.ROND_NUMB ) CURRENT_GOAL ON CURRENT_GOAL.CLUB_NUMB = CURRENT_ROUND.CLUB_NUMB AND CURRENT_GOAL.ROND_NUMB = CURRENT_ROUND.ROND_NUMB
mapper.select:
SELECT /* getMyClubList */
, MINE.MEMB_STAT , MINE.MEMB_ROLE , CURRENT_ROUND.ROND_NUMB AS CURRENT_ROND_NUMB , CURRENT_BOOK.BOOK_TITL AS CURRENT_BOOK_TITL , CURRENT_BOOK.BOOK_CVIM AS CURRENT_BOOK_CVIM , CURRENT_ROUND.GOAL_ENDT AS CURRENT_GOAL_ENDT , CASE WHEN CURRENT_ROUND.ROND_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_GOAL.GOAL_ACHV_CNT, 0) END AS CURRENT_GOAL_ACHV_CNT , CASE WHEN CURRENT_ROUND.ROND_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_GOAL.GOAL_MEMB_CNT, 0) END AS CURRENT_GOAL_MEMB_CNT FROM TB_CLMEMX MINE JOIN TM_CLUBXM CLUB ON CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = MINE.CLUB_NUMB AND CLUB.CLUB_STAT = #{clubActive} LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM OWNER ON OWNER.USER_NUMB = CLUB.OWNR_NUMB
LEFT JOIN TM_BKINFO CURRENT_BOOK ON CURRENT_BOOK.BOOK_NUMB = CURRENT_ROUND.BOOK_NUMB
WHERE MINE.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND MINE.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} ORDER BY MINE.JOIN_DATE DESC , CLUB.CLUB_NUMB DESC

SELECT /* getClubForUpdate */ CLUB.CLUB_NUMB , CLUB.OWNR_NUMB , OWNER.USER_NICK AS OWNR_NICK , CLUB.CLUB_NAME , CLUB.CLUB_CNTN , CLUB.CLUB_VISB , CLUB.JOIN_TYPE , CLUB.CLUB_STAT , CLUB.MAXX_MEMB , CLUB.REGI_DATE FROM TM_CLUBXM CLUB JOIN TM_USERXM OWNER ON OWNER.USER_NUMB = CLUB.OWNR_NUMB WHERE CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getClubCategoryList */ CATEGORY.INTR_CODE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{categoryCode}, CATEGORY.INTR_CODE, NULL) AS INTR_NAME , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{categoryCode}, DETAIL.UPPR_CODE, NULL) AS INTR_CNAM , CATEGORY.SORT_ORDR FROM TB_CLCATE CATEGORY LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD DETAIL ON DETAIL.COMM_CODE = #{categoryCode} AND DETAIL.COMD_CODE = CATEGORY.INTR_CODE WHERE CATEGORY.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} ORDER BY CATEGORY.SORT_ORDR
SELECT /* getClubQuestion */ CLUB_NUMB , QUES_FIRS , QUES_SECO , QUES_THIR , QUES_FOUR , QUES_FIFT FROM TB_CLQUES WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb}
SELECT /* getClubMember */ CLUB_NUMB , USER_NUMB , MEMB_ROLE , MEMB_STAT , EXPR_DATE , BLOC_YSNO FROM TB_CLMEMX WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getClubMemberList */ MEMBER.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , FILEX.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , MEMBER.MEMB_ROLE FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM FILEX ON FILEX.FILE_NUMB = USERX.PROF_NUMB WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} ORDER BY CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_ROLE = #{ownerRole} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , MEMBER.JOIN_DATE , MEMBER.USER_NUMB

SELECT /* getMemberExitList */ MEMBER.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , FILEX.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , MEMBER.EXIT_DATE , MEMBER.BLOC_YSNO FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM FILEX ON FILEX.FILE_NUMB = USERX.PROF_NUMB WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberExited} ORDER BY MEMBER.EXIT_DATE DESC , MEMBER.USER_NUMB DESC

SELECT /* getReadingHistoryList */ ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB , ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB , BOOK.BOOK_TITL , BOOK.BOOK_ATHR , BOOK.BOOK_CVIM , DATE_FORMAT(ROUNDX.GOAL_STDT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS GOAL_STDT , DATE_FORMAT(ROUNDX.GOAL_ENDT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS GOAL_ENDT , COUNT(CASE WHEN PART.ANON_YSNO = #{commNo} AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND USERX.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS PART_CNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN PART.ANON_YSNO = #{commNo} AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND USERX.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND PART.GOAL_YSNO = #{commYes} THEN 1 END) AS GOAL_ACHV_CNT FROM TM_CLRNDX ROUNDX JOIN TM_BKINFO BOOK ON BOOK.BOOK_NUMB = ROUNDX.BOOK_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_CLPART PART ON PART.CLUB_NUMB = ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB AND PART.ROND_NUMB = ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} WHERE ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND ROUNDX.ROND_STAT = #{roundCompleted} GROUP BY ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB , ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB , ROUNDX.BOOK_NUMB , ROUNDX.GOAL_STDT , ROUNDX.GOAL_ENDT , BOOK.BOOK_TITL , BOOK.BOOK_ATHR , BOOK.BOOK_CVIM ORDER BY ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB DESC LIMIT #{pageOffset}, #{pageLimit}

SELECT /* getReadingRoundReportSummary */ ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB , ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB , ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB AS READING_ORDR , BOOK.BOOK_TITL , BOOK.BOOK_ATHR , BOOK.BOOK_CVIM , ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN REPORT.REPT_STAT = #{reportDone} AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND USERX.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(REPORT.REPT_GRDE AS DECIMAL(3, 1)) END), 1) AS RATING_AVERAGE FROM TM_CLRNDX ROUNDX JOIN TM_BKINFO BOOK ON BOOK.BOOK_NUMB = ROUNDX.BOOK_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_CLPART PART ON PART.CLUB_NUMB = ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB AND PART.ROND_NUMB = ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB AND PART.ANON_YSNO = #{commNo} LEFT JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} LEFT JOIN TM_REPORT REPORT ON REPORT.REPT_NUMB = PART.REPT_NUMB AND REPORT.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB WHERE ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB = #{rondNumb} AND ROUNDX.ROND_STAT = #{roundCompleted} GROUP BY ROUNDX.CLUB_NUMB , ROUNDX.ROND_NUMB , ROUNDX.BOOK_NUMB , BOOK.BOOK_TITL , BOOK.BOOK_ATHR , BOOK.BOOK_CVIM

SELECT /* getReadingGoalAchievementMemberList */ USERX.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , FILEX.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , MEMBER.MEMB_ROLE FROM TB_CLPART PART JOIN TB_CLMEMX MEMBER ON MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = PART.CLUB_NUMB AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = PART.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM FILEX ON FILEX.FILE_NUMB = USERX.PROF_NUMB WHERE PART.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND PART.ROND_NUMB = #{rondNumb} AND PART.GOAL_YSNO = #{commYes} AND PART.ANON_YSNO = #{commNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_ROLE = #{ownerRole} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , MEMBER.JOIN_DATE , USERX.USER_NUMB

SELECT /* getMutualFollowCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TB_FOLLOW OWNERFLOW JOIN TB_FOLLOW USERFLOW ON USERFLOW.USER_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB AND USERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.USER_NUMB JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} WHERE OWNERFLOW.USER_NUMB = #{ownerNumb} AND OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getInviteCandidateList */ USERX.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , USERX.INTR_CNTN , FILEX.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(FN_GET_CODE_NAME(DETAIL.COMM_CODE, DETAIL.COMD_CODE, NULL) ORDER BY DETAIL.SORT_ORDR SEPARATOR ' · ') FROM TB_USINTR INTEREST JOIN TB_CODEXD DETAIL ON DETAIL.COMM_CODE = #{categoryCode} AND DETAIL.COMD_CODE = INTEREST.INTR_CODE AND COALESCE(DETAIL.USEE_YSNO, #{commYes}) = #{commYes} WHERE INTEREST.USER_NUMB = USERX.USER_NUMB ) AS INTR_TEXT FROM TB_FOLLOW OWNERFLOW JOIN TB_FOLLOW USERFLOW ON USERFLOW.USER_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB AND USERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.USER_NUMB JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = OWNERFLOW.FLOW_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM FILEX ON FILEX.FILE_NUMB = USERX.PROF_NUMB WHERE OWNERFLOW.USER_NUMB = #{ownerNumb} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.USER_NUMB = USERX.USER_NUMB AND (MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberActive} OR (MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberInvited} AND MEMBER.EXPR_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLJOIN APPLICATION WHERE APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND APPLICATION.USER_NUMB = USERX.USER_NUMB AND APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending} ) ORDER BY USERX.USER_NICK , USERX.USER_NUMB
SELECT /* getOngoingRoundCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TM_CLRNDX WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND ROND_STAT IN (#{roundScheduled}, #{roundReading})

SELECT /* getSentInvitationList */ MEMBER.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , FILEX.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(FN_GET_CODE_NAME(DETAIL.COMM_CODE, DETAIL.COMD_CODE, NULL) ORDER BY DETAIL.SORT_ORDR SEPARATOR ' · ') FROM TB_USINTR INTEREST JOIN TB_CODEXD DETAIL ON DETAIL.COMM_CODE = #{categoryCode} AND DETAIL.COMD_CODE = INTEREST.INTR_CODE AND COALESCE(DETAIL.USEE_YSNO, #{commYes}) = #{commYes} WHERE INTEREST.USER_NUMB = USERX.USER_NUMB ) AS INTR_TEXT , MEMBER.INVT_DATE , MEMBER.EXPR_DATE FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM FILEX ON FILEX.FILE_NUMB = USERX.PROF_NUMB WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.SEND_NUMB = #{ownerNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberInvited} AND MEMBER.EXPR_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY MEMBER.INVT_DATE DESC , MEMBER.USER_NUMB

SELECT /* getInvitationList */ MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB , CLUB.CLUB_NAME , SENDER.USER_NICK AS SENDER_NICK , MEMBER.INVT_DATE , MEMBER.EXPR_DATE FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_CLUBXM CLUB ON CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB AND CLUB.CLUB_STAT = #{clubActive} LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM SENDER ON SENDER.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.SEND_NUMB WHERE MEMBER.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = #{memberInvited} AND MEMBER.EXPR_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY MEMBER.INVT_DATE DESC

SELECT /* getPendingApplication */ CLUB_NUMB , APPL_NUMB , USER_NUMB , QUES_FIRS , QUES_SECO , QUES_THIR , QUES_FOUR , QUES_FIFT , ANSR_FIRS , ANSR_SECO , ANSR_THIR , ANSR_FOUR , ANSR_FIFT , JOIN_STAT , APPL_DATE FROM TB_CLJOIN WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending}

SELECT /* getApplicationList */ APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB , APPLICATION.APPL_NUMB , APPLICATION.USER_NUMB , USERX.USER_NICK , FILEX.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , APPLICATION.QUES_FIRS , APPLICATION.QUES_SECO , APPLICATION.QUES_THIR , APPLICATION.QUES_FOUR , APPLICATION.QUES_FIFT , APPLICATION.ANSR_FIRS , APPLICATION.ANSR_SECO , APPLICATION.ANSR_THIR , APPLICATION.ANSR_FOUR , APPLICATION.ANSR_FIFT , APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT , APPLICATION.APPL_DATE FROM TB_CLJOIN APPLICATION JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = APPLICATION.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM FILEX ON FILEX.FILE_NUMB = USERX.PROF_NUMB WHERE APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending} ORDER BY APPLICATION.APPL_DATE , APPLICATION.APPL_NUMB

SELECT /* getApplicationForUpdate */ APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB , APPLICATION.APPL_NUMB , APPLICATION.USER_NUMB , APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT , APPLICATION.APPL_DATE FROM TB_CLJOIN APPLICATION JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = APPLICATION.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = #{userActive} WHERE APPLICATION.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND APPLICATION.APPL_NUMB = #{applNumb} AND APPLICATION.JOIN_STAT = #{applicationPending} FOR UPDATE
